text.tspan: derived-credit
Accounting completion is not physical caller
completion; close roots only after caller and
reader/GC grace evidence; audit pin never silently
increments marker count
execution-owner
Close generation-aware write admission before drain;
pre-admitted original and alias writers retain
obligations until stopped or acknowledged
writer-closure
Exact count=1-ownedDrop requires zero unaccounted
native credits; strict private-marker profile
rejects generic/reference aliases and raw metadata
writes
storage-commit
Transfer still arena, scanner ownership and
accounting before old PSTATE cleanup; successful
join alone cannot preserve already-freed marker
storage
audit-receipt
Receipt binds generation, closed writer set,
confirmed exit/visibility, root/arena handoff and GC
cut; count alone and timeout do not certify
auditor-transfer
Lost response retains audit write lease; replacement
only after exact auditor cessation and visibility
plus fresh GC cut and reread
single-drop
At exclusive cut, count 1 permits only missing
decrement and count 0 permits recording;
invalidation and decrement have separate progress
gc-cut
Serialize plain refcount/body audit with collector;
preserve independent scanned root at count zero and
keep old storage owned

g.text: SysML -> ASCENT -> QNT / Lean; source + platform OPEN

text.tspan: private-marker-audit
Current code does not establish a universal single-
reference marker invariant; unsafe/open alias paths
reject audit
repeatable-audit
Failed join or response loss cannot release prior lease
or authorize another writer
storage-preservation
Join-only or ordinary root pin does not override
free_still_objs; cleanup path must be refactored
modern-c-net-benefit
Net gain depends on a genuinely closed private-marker
domain and shared support; no runtime speed or Zig-
specific saving established
